themes.title: Right-Wing Political Alignment & Electoral Strategy
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe and North America are maneuvering to solidify power, debate coalition strategies, and manage electoral headwinds. From municipal governance deals in Scandinavia to presidential positioning in France and midterm strategy in the United States, conservative movements are balancing pragmatism with ideological commitments.
